title: Count every instance
prompt: Implement `class Tracked` with an `inline static int live_;` and `inline static int created_;`. The constructor increments both; the destructor decrements `live_`. Provide static getters `int live()` and `int created()`.

tests.name: created
tests.hint: created_ never decreases — it counts every construction.

tests.name: live
tests.hint: x died in the block; only y remains.

tests.name: no-instance
tests.hint: Static getters work without any instance.
